evidence_quote: We describe the development of a WBPS model of the Terminal 1 of FCO airport.
The calibration method used is performed by analysing and varying a set of input values iteratively to meet calibration criteria.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The building modelled is Terminal 1 at Fiumicino Rome Airport (Latitude 41.8° North, Longitude 12.23° East).

mv_protocol.evidence_quote: Regarding the period of calibration, a full 8760 hour data set is needed for an accurate calibration as defined by ASHRAE guideline 14 (ASHRAE 2002).
